title: Data subject request: send everything on this person
scenario: An email citing data-protection law demands your team send everything held about a named individual within 48 hours, with no verification of identity or authority attached.

answers.A: Compile and send the requested data quickly to comply with the law.
answers.B: Route the request through your organization's official data-protection process before sending anything.
answers.C: Send a partial file quickly and promise the rest later.

explanation: Legitimate data-subject requests go through a verified intake process precisely because unverified requests are a known vector for extracting sensitive personal data.
proTip: A legal-sounding deadline doesn't replace your organization's real verification process.
